name: Pale Brush
description: Brush a pale glamour across the foe's brow so that his eyes slide off the user for a moment.

name: Lull Fist
description: Strike after a slow false wind-up that lulls the foe into reading the blow as weak.

name: Veil Edge
description: Raise the edge of a hand veiled in light to shear a blow into the air beside the body.

name: Sidelong Pace
description: Pace off the line while the shape of the body keeps facing the foe.

name: Echo Image
description: Leave an image that repeats the user's last motion a breath late while the true body is already elsewhere.

name: Counterfeit Shot
description: Loose one real bolt of qi among a dozen false ones that fly in the same line.

name: Vanishing Presence
description: Fade from sight and sound and scent together so that no sense of the foe can find the user for two breaths.

name: Phantom Retinue
description: Call a dozen armed phantoms about the user that strike all near and draw the aim of every foe.

name: Open Mirage
description: Open a small mirage before the foe that shows a path where none runs.

name: Wide Palm
description: Strike with a palm that seems twice its true width so that the foe misjudges its reach.

name: Gauze Shield
description: Spread a gauze of drifting images that softens each blow and blurs where it lands.

name: Drifting Outline
description: Drift sideways a pace while the image of the body keeps its place a moment longer.

name: Stretched Distance
description: Stretch the apparent gap between user and foe so that every step he takes seems to gain nothing.

name: Mirage Spear
description: Hurl a spear of qi hidden in the image of drifting mist that pierces guards without a sound.

name: Depth Reading
description: Read the layers of a mirage from the front to the rear to find the one real thing behind them.

name: Wide Mirage
description: Stretch a single mirage over an entire company so that all within it see the same false scene.

name: Mirage Collapse
description: Fold a wide mirage in on itself in a burst that rattles the senses and hurls back all within it.

name: Veiled Glamour
description: Spread a veil through the qi field about the body so that outlines inside it run together.

name: Aura Jab
description: Jab with a fist wrapped in the false aura of a weaker fighter so that the foe holds back his guard.

name: Condensed Mirror
description: Hold a mirror of condensed qi at the forearm to turn the line of a strike.

name: Sheen Pace
description: Cross a short gap in a streak of sheen that leaves the foe blinking at the empty air.

name: Anchor Taste
description: Taste the qi field for the strain of a false image and learn where it is anchored.

name: Rewriting Seeming
description: Fill the qi field with a seeming that rewrites the look of the ground and the air within it.

name: Sheen Lance
description: Drive a lance of dense sheen through a guard that the foe thought was empty air.

name: Seeming Break
description: Break a seeming that clings to an ally by pressing a cool pulse of qi into his temples.

name: Living Seeming
description: Raise a seeming through the whole qi field that wraps every ally in a false look and takes the first blows.

name: Hidden Tide
description: Pour a tide of unseen force through the field that strikes foes who watch only the false waves above it.

name: Paired Veil
description: Cast two veils at once so that the foe must lift both before he can see the user.

name: Twin Jab
description: Throw two jabs from two places so that one is real and one is only its twin.

name: Pair Mirror
description: Set two small mirrors of qi at the wrists to turn a strike from either side.

name: Twinned Stride
description: Take two paces in two directions at once with the true body and a copy.

name: Falcon Lens
description: Sharpen the gaze with qi until the fine seam of a false image shows even at long range.

name: Twinned Flare
description: Flare two points of light at the foe's eyes so that he cannot settle on either.

name: Twin Mirage
description: Raise two mirages of the user that walk in step so that the foe cannot learn which one leads.

name: Twin Phantasm
description: Send a second body of dense phantasm in at the foe's flank as the first strikes from the front.

name: Pair Unveil
description: Clasp an ally between two hands of clearing qi and strip the false pictures from his sight.

name: Doubled Presence
description: Hold two full bodies of equal weight in the field and swap them whenever a blow comes in.

name: Mirrored Verdict
description: Cast a flawless image of the foe against himself so that his own motion is returned in a heavy blow.

name: Wing Glamour
description: Cast the image of a wing across the foe's sight to hide the user's approach.

name: Talon Shimmer
description: Rake with hooked fingers that glint with false talons far longer than the true reach.

name: Plume Turn
description: Spread a fan of false feathers at the guard to brush a blow wide of its mark.

name: Soar Slip
description: Rise on the toes in a light leap while a bird-shaped image flaps in the opposite direction.

name: Stooping Shade
description: Cast the sliding shadow of a hawk across the ground so that the foe flinches from above.

name: Dive Phantom
description: Drop a phantom hawk on the foe and strike in the instant he looks up.

name: Keen Hawk
description: Send a hawk of pure sight aloft to read a whole scene and pick out the false from the real.

name: Feathered Veil
description: Wrap the body in a mantle of layered wings that turns blows and hides the shape beneath.

name: Hawk Mirage Rain
description: Rain a hundred phantom hawks onto an area so that each stoop wounds as well as bewilders.

name: Ripple Veil
description: Cast a ripple over the foe's sight so that the user seems to sway as in moving water.

name: Sheen Fist
description: Strike with a fist that throws a shifting sheen so that its path cannot be fixed.

name: Undulant Guard
description: Send a ripple through the guard that bends the line of a strike away from the body.

name: Eddy Pace
description: Turn on the heel in a small eddy of motion that leaves the foe facing a vanishing shape.

name: Gathered Lens
description: Gather qi in the eyes like water in a lens and see the true form beneath any glamour.

name: Ripple Flick
description: Flick a ripple of false light across the foe's eyes to spoil his reading of the strike.

name: Flowing Mirage
description: Let a mirage flow outward from the user so that it changes its look as it spreads.

name: Mirrored Volley
description: Gather false shapes and loose them together as one volley of bolts that echo after one another.

name: Current Phantom
description: Run a phantom current along the ground that surfaces under the foe and drives up through his stance.

name: Clearing Ripple
description: Send a clean ripple through an ally's senses that washes out every false picture laid in them.

name: Phantasm Flood
description: Release a flood of false shapes from the gathered field that sweeps away the footing of all in its path.

name: Stilled Return
description: Hold a still plane of qi before the body and throw an attack back at its source in a perfect mirror.

name: Oath Glamour
description: Pull a sworn veil across the foe's sight that holds until he turns his face from it.

name: Draft Jab
description: Jab on the beat of a false draft of air that makes the foe sway from the true line.

name: Tilted Guard
description: Hold the guard on a false bearing so that the blow is aimed to the side of the body.

name: Veered Slip
description: Veer off the line of a strike on a puff of false wind that hides the first step.

name: Oath Eye
description: Swear the gaze to the truth and hold it on a shape until its glamour gives way.

name: Windblown Image
description: Blow the user's image across the air like smoke so that the foe chases it downwind.

name: Gust Phantasm
description: Loose phantoms on a gust that burst against the foe and sting like flung grit.

name: Lost Bearing
description: Twist a foe's sense of direction until his own left and right swap places in his mind.

name: Oathbound Mirage
description: Swear a mirage to a spot so that a foe who enters it cannot leave in the direction he intends.

name: Sworn Double
description: Bind a full double to the user's oath so that it takes the true blow and the user stands unharmed.

name: Level Veil
description: Smooth every rise and fall in the foe's view until the ground reads as flat.

name: Even Jab
description: Jab at an even pace with an image that never changes speed until the true blow quickens.

name: Steady Mirror
description: Hold a motionless mirror of qi at the guard so that a strike slides away along its face.

name: Broad Pace
description: Cover a wide gap in one stride while a flat image of the body stays where it began.

name: Bearing Mirage
description: Hold a mirage that shows a false bearing so that the foe walks steadily toward the wrong place.

name: Stone Phantom
description: Hide a spike of dense qi in the image of a flat stone and drive it up through the foe's guard.

name: Oathfast Seeming
description: Pin a foe in place with a seeming that tells him every way out is a way back.

name: Level Falsehood
description: Spread one flat false world over a wide area and strike through it where the foes believe nothing stands.

name: Heading Glamour
description: Turn the foe's sense of the user's bearing a few degrees aside with a thin veil.

name: Vowed Jab
description: Jab on a sworn line that the foe's eye reads as a different line.

name: Turned Mirror
description: Turn a small mirror of qi at the guard to send the strike off at a sworn angle.

name: Kept Heading
description: Hold a bearing through a step and leave a copy that keeps going on the old heading.

name: Honest Heading
description: Read the real heading of every figure in view and mark which ones move by false light.

name: Draught Flare
description: Flare a bright false gust before the foe's eyes to break his set stance.

name: Sworn Mirage
description: Swear a mirage into place so that it does not waver however the foe may strike at it.

name: Oath Phantasm
description: Loose a phantasm sworn to its target that bends in flight to follow every dodge.

name: Vowed Lance
description: Drive a lance sworn to a single point through the false guard the foe has been led to raise.

name: Veil Clearing
description: Clear the veil from an ally's mind by sweeping a steady wind of qi through his thoughts.

name: Skewed Heading
description: Break the sense of direction of every foe within the field so that each marches to a different heading.

name: Sworn Phantasm
description: Cast an oath-bound phantasm over all the foes at once and press each to his knees under its weight.
